sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: LORAN C Station at Patpur was de-commissioned on 2006, since then one LHA was posted to look after the station.

sections.title: Electricity
sections.text: Single Phase, 230V, 50Hz Electric Mains Supply is available from CESU.

sections.title: Water Supply
sections.text: Open well is available in the station for water.

sections.title: Mode ofApproach
sections.text: The station is well connected by all weather road. The nearest Railway Station is Cuttack railway station which is approx. 12 Km and nearest Airport is Bhubaneswar which is approx. 22 km from Station.

sections.title: Facilities Available
sections.text:
Post Office, Primary Health Center, Police Station and Kendra Vidyalaya all are within radius of 6 KM from Patpur LORAN C Station.
Single Phase, 230V, 50Hz Electric Mains Supply is available from WBEDCL.
